text:
maria: Quick brainstorm 10
We need a clear benchmark narrative for the launch. Prefer the phrase 'Speed vs. Spend' for the public-facing copy. Audience: product + platform engineers at mid-market and platform leads. Deliverables: 2 charts, 2 slide mockups, 1 short explainer paragraph, and inbound routing CTAs. Who can take slides/data/copy?

alex: I can take slides. Chart ideas: (1) tokens/sec (x) vs $/1k tokens (y) as the hero; (2) latency percentiles (p50/p95/p99) vs $/request as small multiples by model family. Use log scale on cost axis so differences are visible. Keep legends big.

sam: I'll write explainer copy. Suggest a 1-line "how to read" under each chart and a 1-line methodology note. Also provide two headline variants for A/B testing.

jamal: I'll extract data for models: rw-compact-8q, rw-standard-16, open-v-fast, open-v-hq. Include fp16 and quantized variants. Also prepare a routing scenario (70% fast / 30% high-quality) and simulated cost-per-completed-query. Expect CSV by Tue noon.

olivia: Landing page routing: create two funnels. SMB: sign-up -> quickstart -> auto-cost-estimate widget. Enterprise: sign-up -> demo request -> capacity pricing follow-up. Landing should let visitors choose "I care about latency" or "I care about price" and route content. CTAs to test: "Estimate your per-request cost" vs "See latency at scale".

benchbot: perf dump link: https://internal/redwood/bench/2800_dump.csv (includes tokens/sec, mean/p95/p99 latencies, cost estimates).

maria: Nice. Timeline: slides WIP by Tue EOD, data + copy by Tue noon, sync Wed 10am to finalize webinar order. Small asks: annotate one real-world example (chat search vs summarization), include routing guardrails slide, and ensure thumbnails readable.

alex: Slide plan: slide 1 hero chart with 3 large dots and callouts (speed vs spend). slide 2 small multiples of p50/p95/p99 with routing overlay and a tiny GIF showing a request switching routes. Chart config I'll use:
```
{x: "tokens_per_second", y: "cost_per_1k", color: "model_variant", scale_y: "log", annotations: ["p95_ms", "recommended_route"]}
```

sam: Draft headlines: A) "Optimize for speed and spend" B) "Latency where you need it, cost where you want it" 1 leaning A. Explainer paragraph draft: "Ship faster without blowing budgets. We measured tokens/sec and latency percentiles across model variants and quantization modes to show tradeoffs. Use routing policies to favor cheaper variants during bursts while preserving SLA for critical requests." Will include bullets: what we measured, how to read charts, how to adopt.

jamal: CSV will include quantized vs fp16 metrics plus simulated routing case. I'll also add a small column with cost-per-completed-query for two query lengths (short/long).

olivia: I'll wire hero landing in Figma and add toggle content blocks for latency vs price. Also adding a demo CTA linking to capacity calculator for enterprise.

maria: Great. Final notes: avoid technical jargon on public slide headers, but keep methodology in a footnote. Add a single-slide 'how to adopt' with steps: quickstart benchmark -> set routing policy -> monitor cost/latency in Console -> roll to prod. Thanks team :rocket:
